"Success aksar unko milta jo itne busy hote, search nahi karte."
"Success ya failure mindset pe depend."
Winners control mein jo hai uspe focus.
Duniya badalne wale pagal hote hain.
"Humare choices hi batate—hum asli mein kya hain."
"Jahan ho, wahi se start."
Badlav ko apnayo.
Tumhara samay seemit hai, ise kisi aur ki zindagi jeene mein barbad mat karo.
"Great work ka way: usse pyaar."
Jo bhi karo, pure dil se karo.
Effort ka substitute nahi.
